text:
Situation: Soybean oil 20 g/100 mL 1000 mL is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 58 units (17.2 days on hand), Corvale General holds 48 units (11.1 days), and Corvale Lakeside holds 9 units (10.2 days). The labeler and manufacturer is B. Braun Medical Inc.

Why (FDA record): FDA’s drug shortage list does not include soybean oil as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is limited at Lakeside and General with approximately 10–11 days on hand. East has a more comfortable buffer. No national shortage is declared, but site-level risk exists if allocation shifts or demand increases.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy buyer to contact B. Braun Medical Inc. for allocation status and estimated delivery dates; report to P&T chair.
2. Pharmacy buyer to initiate inter-facility transfer from East to Lakeside and General to normalize days on hand above 14 days; requires P&T chair approval.
3. Pharmacy buyer to identify and qualify alternative lipid emulsion presentations or manufacturers for contingency purchasing; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Inventory team to implement daily monitoring and set reorder alerts at 14 days on hand for all sites; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Declaring a systemwide shortage or restricting clinical use while FDA lists no shortage and total system inventory exceeds 38 days combined.
